name: Cold call
summary: A 15-second opener, a gatekeeper or a brush-off, and one shot at a next step.
repBrief: You are cold-calling to sell Shiftwise. The buyer did not expect your call. You have about 15 seconds to earn the next 60. Goal: a booked follow-up meeting.
buyerBrief: You did not expect this call. You answer the phone, then decide quickly whether this person deserves more of your time. Treat it as an interruption until they earn otherwise.
winCondition: The buyer agrees to a specific follow-up meeting or call.
